summary.en: US equity futures were lower ahead of Thanksgiving as investors assessed reports of possible new US tariffs. October PCE inflation rose 3.8% year over year, third-quarter real GDP growth was revised to 4.3% annualized, and initial jobless claims fell to 189,000.
summary.zh: 感恩节前美股期货走低，市场关注美国可能加征关税的报道。10月PCE物价指数同比上涨3.8%，三季度实际GDP增速上修至年化4.3%，初请失业金人数降至18.9万。

title.en: US equity futures fall ahead of Thanksgiving as tariff reports draw attention
title.zh: 感恩节前美股期货下跌，关税报道引发关注

impact.en: MT Newswires reported at 07:41 ET that traders were assessing reports of possible US tariffs on major trading partners. The later frozen quote shows Nasdaq-100 futures down 3.13% against the prior 16:00 ET futures reference. The 08:30 ET PCE results are covered separately below.
impact.zh: MT Newswires在美东07:41报道，交易者正评估美国可能对主要贸易伙伴加征关税的消息。较晚的盘前快照显示，纳指100期货较前一日美东16:00的同合约参考价下跌3.13%。美东08:30公布的PCE数据见下文。

bullish: The 10-year Treasury yield fell 6.4 bp to 4.840% versus the prior 15:00 ET reference. / 10年期美债收益率较前一日美东15:00的参考值下降6.4个基点至4.840%。
bearish: The tariff reports add uncertainty for prices and supply chains if the proposals are implemented. / 若相关关税提议落地，价格和供应链面临的不确定性将增加。

macroRisk.en: Watch whether the early losses broaden after the 09:30 ET cash open. The Fed’s Beige Book is scheduled for 14:00 ET.
macroRisk.zh: 观察美东09:30现货开盘后跌势是否扩散。美联储褐皮书定于美东14:00发布。

title.en: BEA Reports October PCE Price Index Up 3.8% Year-Over-Year
title.zh: BEA报告10月PCE物价指数同比上涨3.8%

impact.en: The October PCE price index rose 0.3% month over month and 3.8% year over year, matching the Bloomberg consensus cited in the earlier market report. Core PCE rose 0.3% month over month and 3.3% year over year.
impact.zh: 10月PCE物价指数环比上涨0.3%、同比上涨3.8%，与早间市场报道引用的彭博调查预期一致。核心PCE物价指数环比上涨0.3%、同比上涨3.3%。

bullish: Nominal personal income rose 0.7% month over month in October. / 10月名义个人收入环比增长0.7%。
bearish: Nominal PCE rose 0.3% month over month, while real PCE declined by less than 0.1%. / 名义个人消费支出环比增长0.3%，实际消费支出环比下降不到0.1%。

macroRisk.en: Persistent core inflation could keep the Fed cautious about easing.
macroRisk.zh: 若核心通胀持续偏高，美联储对放松政策可能继续保持谨慎。

title.en: BEA Revises Q3 GDP Growth Up to 4.3% Annualized Rate
title.zh: 美国经济分析局上修第三季度实际 GDP 折年增长率至 4.3%

impact.en: Real GDP rose at a 4.3% annualized rate in Q3, 0.9 percentage point above the advance estimate. Investment and consumer spending drove the revision. Faster investment growth and a turn higher in government spending drove most of the acceleration from Q2.
impact.zh: 三季度实际GDP年化增长4.3%，较初值上调0.9个百分点。投资和消费推动了此次上修。与二季度相比，经济增长加快主要来自投资提速和政府支出转增。

bullish: Real final sales to private domestic purchasers rose at a 5.8% annualized rate in Q3. / 三季度对国内私人购买者的实际最终销售年化增长5.8%。
bearish: Exports fell and imports rose in Q3, subtracting from GDP growth. / 三季度出口下降、进口增加，拖累GDP增长。

macroRisk.en: Steady demand alongside elevated inflation could keep policy restrictive.
macroRisk.zh: 需求稳健而通胀仍偏高，可能使货币政策继续偏紧。

title.en: Initial Jobless Claims Fall to 189,000 in Week Ending Nov 21
title.zh: 截至11月21日当周初请失业金人数降至18.9万

impact.en: Seasonally adjusted initial claims fell by 13,000 to 189,000 from a revised 202,000 the prior week. The four-week average fell by 1,500 to 196,000.
impact.zh: 经季节调整的初请失业金人数较前一周修正后的20.2万减少1.3万，降至18.9万。四周均值下降1,500人至19.6万。

bullish: The lower four-week average supports the near-term picture of contained layoffs. / 四周均值下降，显示近期裁员压力尚有限。

macroRisk.en: Holiday-week figures may be volatile. Watch whether the four-week trend persists.
macroRisk.zh: 假期前后单周数据可能波动，后续可观察四周均值的下降趋势能否持续。

note.en: The premarket setup leans defensive. Nasdaq-100 futures fell 3.13% and S&P 500 futures fell 2.06% versus their prior-session reference, while the latest inflation and GDP figures leave the rate path uncertain. The strongest offsetting signal is the 10-year Treasury yield at 4.840%, down 6.4 basis points versus its prior reference, which offers some relief to rate-sensitive shares. If market breadth improves after the 09:30 ET cash open while yields stay lower, an early stabilization would have broader support. If weakness spreads beyond tech, the defensive signal strengthens.
note.zh: 盘前整体偏防守。纳指100期货和标普500期货较前一交易日参考值分别下跌3.13%和2.06%，最新通胀和GDP数据也让利率路径仍不明朗。最明显的反向信号是10年期美债收益率报4.840%，较前一参考值下降6.4个基点，对利率敏感板块有所支撑。若美东09:30现货开盘后上涨家数增加，且收益率维持较低水平，企稳将获得更广泛的支持。若跌势扩散至科技板块之外，盘前偏防守的信号会增强。
